name: numeric-application-copy-duplicates-complete-subtree
note: Ordinary numeric Application source duplicates Group/NetVar/Level descendants with fresh disjoint OIDs; source XML byte-identical; 301 receipt, no implicit SAVE/retry/PCI.

name: oid-application-copy-matches-numeric
note: Admitted !oid Application selector with numeric parent routes to the same atomic subtree copy with fresh identities.

name: numeric-group-copy-preserves-levels
note: Numeric Group source duplicates its Levels with retained values under fresh OIDs; caller-supplied address/tag at root only.

name: oid-group-copy-preserves-levels
note: Admitted !oid Group selector duplicates Levels identically to the numeric selector with disjoint identities.

name: numeric-level-copy-retains-value-for-initializer
note: Numeric Level copy carries the source Value; the typed CLI then runs its value initializer on the fresh OID.

name: oid-level-copy-null-initializer-flow
note: Admitted !oid Level copy keeps the established NULL-value 301 flow so the caller initializer runs; parents must be numeric.

name: netvar-copy-preserves-child-levels
note: NetVar source duplicates its child Levels with retained values under fresh OIDs; numeric and OID readback both resolve.

name: null-level-copy-preserves-null
note: A Level with native NULL Value (no Value attribute) copies as NULL; DBGET !oid/Value reads null on both source and copy until initialized.

name: group-tagsdlt-labels-travel-with-fresh-inner-oids
note: Group TagsDLT label rows travel verbatim except their embedded TagDLT OIDs, which are reminted so source and copy share no label identity.

name: level-tagsdlt-labels-travel-with-fresh-inner-oids
note: Level TagsDLT label rows travel with reminted inner OIDs; LanguageID/FlavourID/TagType/TagValue bytes preserved.

name: xml-extras-namespaces-attributes-preserved
note: Retained namespaced attributes/children and extension markup travel with their owner; only embedded OIDs are reminted.

name: destination-application-conflict-refuses-atomically
note: Occupied destination address refuses 409 before mutation; source, destination network and roster snapshots unchanged.

name: destination-group-conflict-refuses-atomically
note: Occupied Group address refuses 409 without partial inserts.

name: destination-level-conflict-refuses-atomically
note: Occupied Level address refuses 409 without partial inserts.

body: 401 Complete typed Application source not found
final: 401 Complete typed Application source not found
name: missing-source-refuses-without-mutation
note: Unknown numeric source refuses 401 with no graph mutation.

body: 408 Source and destination parent element types do not match
final: 408 Source and destination parent element types do not match
name: wrong-parent-kind-refuses-without-mutation
note: Application source with Group parent (and Group source with Network parent) refuses 401 without mutation.

name: cross-project-source-isolation
note: Application copies between loaded projects are admitted by the Application-copy owner (application-database-safe.md); the source project stays byte-identical and only the destination gains the copy.

name: copy-survives-save-close-load
note: PROJECT SAVE/CLOSE/LOAD preserves the copied subtree, its values/labels and the durable Application roster; OIDs stable across reload.

name: lost-success-does-not-replay
note: Typed CLI sends DBGETXML preread + DBCOPYSAFE once on one connection; a dropped success reply surfaces without reconnect or replay.

name: zero-pci-traffic-and-roster-append-once
note: Database copy performs no PCI/CNI traffic; the new Application appends once to the durable Network roster and refusals append nothing.
